rule: QoIs requiring vorticity or other derived velocity-gradient fields (enstrophy, circulation, streamfunction saddle topology) are unextractable on the cavity_2d/icoFoam substrate, which only reduces already-written fields; such hypotheses must be redesigned onto a global-reducible proxy or routed to an instrument with field-derivative post-processing.
suggested_scope: Design/QoI-selection stage for any cavity_2d hypothesis involving vorticity, circulation, or streamfunction quantities

rule: The substrate exposes only whole-domain volAverage/min/max/volIntegrate over U/p and never raw field arrays, so any QoI needing spatial masking or sub-domain decomposition (corner-excluded core pressure, corner-eddy chords, primary-vortex KE fraction, recirculation-region counts) is untestable without added offline post-processing.
suggested_scope: QoI feasibility screening for spatially-localized observables in the lid-driven cavity

rule: Non-canonical geometry or spatially-varying lid boundary conditions (central obstacles, S-shaped/multi-block meshes, codedFixedValue/bimodal lid profiles, non-square aspect ratios) halt the case builder, which accepts only its canonical scalar parameter vocabulary; such hypotheses require builder extension or a different instrument before any run.
suggested_scope: Instrument-fit check before dispatching any non-canonical-geometry or custom-BC cavity design

rule: Global field extrema are dominated by singular/primary-flow features rather than the secondary structures under study: min(Uy) saturates with Re and is insensitive to corner vortices, and min(p) is set by the non-convergent top-lid corner singularity — so global extremum QoIs are unfaithful proxies for secondary-vortex or core-pressure claims.
suggested_scope: Validity assessment of global min/max QoIs targeting secondary or core-localized flow features

rule: At gate 1 the system's rank-1 selection is consistently overridden by the human to a lower-ranked option, while gate 2 approvals are never overridden — indicating the ranking model over-prefers its top candidate at selection time.

Gate 5 repeatedly returns designs to back_to_design or more_data across runs, and the fidelity ledger records the matching outcomes as defer/refine with no verified y/n resolution (Brier uncomputable, all 18 unresolved), showing designs on this substrate systematically fail to reach an executed, scored outcome.
suggested_scope: Pipeline-level throughput and gate-5 loopback on cavity_2d experiments

rule: Specs are frequently constructed as duplicate experiments — the pi-gate sweep flags 20 specs for repeated Re within tolerance and the anomaly scanner finds identical QoI values (volAverage|U| = 0.416835 and 0.193007) across distinct runs — so dispatched sweeps should be de-duplicated before execution.
suggested_scope: Pre-dispatch spec validation / de-duplication of Re sweeps

rule: Courant/stability limits are a recurring on-disk risk: the pi-gate sweep flags 15 specs for estimated Courant exceeding its limit, and the anomaly scanner shows max_Courant outliers (~0.60) far above the IQR fence — timestep/mesh spacing should be checked against U*dt/dx before running.
suggested_scope: Numerical-stability pre-check on time_step/mesh_resolution before solver dispatch
